    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:53.700
    | text      = Once you get mad at the Dixie Chicks, January 6th is going to happen.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:57.340
    | text      = Yeah, so like Liberty's tough.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.500
    | text      = Even for these brave men who didn't have the ACLU and the PETA yelling at them by the other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:05.940
    | text      = racists and they beat dogs or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.460
    | text      = Crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:10.460
    | text      = Oh man, you know what I loved about the Alamo story?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:14.000
    | text      = No PETA.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.100
    | text      = That was the main thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:16.519
    | text      = Also no Greek food.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:18.039
    | text      = So it all worked out all across the board.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:21.159
    | text      = So Alex continues to read from Baldwin's essay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:25.440
    | text      = The brave men at the Alamo labored under the belief that America and Texas really was the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:31.159
    | text      = land of the free and the home of the brave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:33.820
    | text      = They believed God was on their side and that the freedom of future generations depended
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.759
    | text      = on their courage and resolve.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:42.120
    | text      = They further believed that posterity would remember their sacrifice as an act of love
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:47.639
    | text      = and devotion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.279
    | text      = It all looks pale now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.440
    | text      = By today's standards, the gallant men of the Alamo appear rather foolish.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:55.360
    | text      = After all, they had no chance of winning.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:57.360
    | text      = None.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:58.360
    | text      = However, the call for a pragmatism and practicality was never sounded.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.279
    | text      = Instead, they answered the clarion call, victory or death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:09.259
    | text      = And in closing, please try to remember the heroes of the Alamo as you listen to your
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:14.659
    | text      = gutless political and religious leaders calling for compromise and tolerance.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:19.139
    | text      = Try to recall the time in this country when ordinary men and women had the courage of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.179
    | text      = their convictions and were willing to sacrifice their lives for freedom and independence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:28.259
    | text      = Is that what they were doing?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:29.259
    | text      = One thing is certain, those courageous champions did not die for a political party or for some
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:35.580
    | text      = lesser of two evils.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:37.340
    | text      = So did the men at Lexington and Concord.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:42.700
    | text      = This is our heritage, our birthright, my friends.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:46.940
    | text      = And on second thought, don't they look foolish or do we look foolish?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:53.860
    | text      = And I flummoxed that there at the end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:56.139
    | text      = On second thought, do they look foolish or do we?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:59.460
    | text      = Not a newsreader, folks, like Peter Jennings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:01.539
    | text      = So when I have the derisive and disgusted tone about Alex in the present day resorting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:06.299
    | text      = to lesser of two evils arguments in order to justify Trump's actions, that's why.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:10.899
    | text      = It's hard not to think, maybe that guy wouldn't do that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:13.659
    | text      = It's easy to lose sight of this because he's entirely lost his shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.500
    | text      = But in the past, Alex was a total blowhard about integrity and principle and all that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.539
    | text      = shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:23.539
    | text      = He loved it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.539
    | text      = Yeah, it's crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.940
    | text      = I mean, now there needs to be some sort of time travel situation wherein we can see how
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.220
    | text      = so you know, like, like this is a and it's a wonderful life situation, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:40.580
    | text      = We're all in the simulation of what would happen if Alex did whatever he did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:45.100
    | text      = You know, like that person in 2006 is the only person who's actually alive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:50.740
    | text      = We're all living the dream.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.100
    | text      = And then in a little bit, whenever it goes real south, that person's going to wake up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:56.259
    | text      = and go, I guess I'll have to change my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:57.940
    | text      = That's what I think is happening, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:59.860
    | text      = I hope not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:00.860
    | text      = But I will say, you know, it's not exactly the same thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:05.180
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:06.180
    | text      = But I wonder if Alex got a call from his future self later in this episode.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:11.339
    | text      = There is a caller who sounds a little bit like he has a criticism of Alex that would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:17.900
    | text      = come from his future self.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:18.900
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.900
    | text      = Fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:20.900
    | text      = But we'll get to that a little bit later.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:21.900
    | text      = Fantastic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:22.900
    | text      = For now, Alex has to complain about how like, you can't be pushed around by the feds.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:27.539
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:28.539
    | text      = I just want to set the stage with that and understand that when you have an attitude,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:32.740
    | text      = you're willing to fight and die, you're not going to be pushed around or shoved around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:37.019
    | text      = You get left alone, you have liberty, and then you're able to produce plenty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:41.660
    | text      = And then you become happy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:43.220
    | text      = And then your children become decadent, their children become even more decadent, their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:46.619
    | text      = children become cross and corrupt, evil, and then you get tyranny.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:51.619
    | text      = And then you go right through the cycle again, if you're lucky.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:55.420
    | text      = Normally the cycle isn't broken, and you just live in abject slavery and tyranny, and countries
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:59.980
    | text      = fail and they're not productive or powerful or well known.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:03.859
    | text      = The real empires of the world were forged through a zenith, through a genesis, through
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:11.099
    | text      = a beginning of liberty, at least more liberty than their neighbors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.579
    | text      = It didn't matter what color they were, what culture they were, where there is liberty,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:20.859
    | text      = there is freedom, there is happiness, there is productivity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.099
    | text      = This is all great stuff, but it's a lie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:27.339
    | text      = This is all built on a lie.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:29.420
    | text      = The greatest myth that folks like Alex sold to their followers is that they just want
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:33.339
    | text      = to be left alone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:34.920
    | text      = And the reason that's been so damaging is it's totally understandable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:39.019
    | text      = A lot of people just want to live their lives in peace and sincerely don't care what other
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:43.319
    | text      = folks get into in their private lives, so when Alex dresses his beliefs up that way,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.140
    | text      = it's really relatable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.180
    | text      = But Alex and his ilk don't want to be left alone, they want to impose a culture on all
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:54.740
    | text      = of us that makes them feel like they're being left alone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:58.740
    | text      = It bothers them if a teacher at their kid's school is gay, so they want to outlaw that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:03.279
    | text      = It bothers them to see mixed-race couples on TV, so they want a culture that doesn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:07.420
    | text      = include that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:09.059
    | text      = For most of us, when we hear the government should leave us alone, we can nod along thinking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:12.980
    | text      = about weird taxes or how they shouldn't arrest you for weed, but that wasn't what Alex was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:17.420
    | text      = ever talking about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:18.420
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:19.420
    | text      = And he got a lot of mileage out of people thinking that he was.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.259
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, you know, we probably should have, we probably should have really put together
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.359
    | text      = the thoughts of like somebody who's like, we're really into the Alamo because we want
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:31.880
    | text      = to be left alone, and then think like maybe the Alamo wasn't about being left alone so
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:36.579
    | text      = much as being suddenly very alone in a land that's not yours that you now get to keep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.920
    | text      = And I think that what it all comes down to is, you know, Alex is 20 years on, I think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.839
    | text      = he's shown that don't let yourself get pushed around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:54.319
    | text      = There's something to it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:56.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:58.119
    | text      = I mean, it's a bummer when you go back and you listen to him say things that sound like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:02.880
    | text      = they're useful because in our world, right, and in the world of people listening to this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:10.099
    | text      = when they hear somebody say words, right, they associate that person with the meaning
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:15.319
    | text      = of those words, as opposed to somebody who is using those words like a whip or a tool
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:22.119
    | text      = to lie to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:23.119
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:24.119
    | text      = And so when you hear it from Alex, you go, those are the words that I think are true,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:28.839
    | text      = right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:29.839
    | text      = But they're not coming from that person because they're not, that person stole words that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.000
    | text      = were good and used them to hurt you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:36.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:37.480
    | text      = A person who's operating from a place of like good faith and good intention could say the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:42.539
    | text      = same thing and it be like, eh, all right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:45.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:46.440
    | text      = I hear you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:47.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:48.440
    | text      = But yeah, but Alex is lying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:49.440
    | text      = No, he's-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:50.440
    | text      = And we know that from being 20 years in the future.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.440
    | text      = Yeah, because now we're here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:52.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:53.759
    | text      = This isn't sincere.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:54.759
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:55.759
    | text      = Anyway, 20 years on now, one of the things that I think that we're seeing is a great
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:01.119
    | text      = deal of centralization of power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:03.480
    | text      = You have Trump taking on-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:06.039
    | text      = The end.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:07.039
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:08.039
    | text      = That administration is, he seems to be, you know, pulling some strings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:13.480
    | text      = Pretty hard in charge, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:15.799
    | text      = You'd be surprised to learn that this was bad-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:18.680
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:19.680
    | text      = For Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:20.680
    | text      = When?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:21.680
    | text      = His whole career.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:22.920
    | text      = To throw off the left-right paradigm, to realize we're all in this together as humans,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:27.519
    | text      = and to realize that any centralization of government, whether it's under some left hood
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:31.680
    | text      = or some right hood, that is whatever hat you put on it, it is still the same creature and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:38.480
    | text      = centralization allows corrupt elites to dominate and control.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:42.160
    | text      = The answer is decentralization.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:45.880
    | text      = We must bind the lesser areas of human nature.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:52.079
    | text      = We must restrict the dark impulses, and to deny them is to invite certain ruin.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:58.920
    | text      = Didn't mean any of that shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:00.759
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:01.759
    | text      = Not at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:02.759
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:03.759
    | text      = Does he even know, you know, I wonder, does he even know what those words mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:06.319
    | text      = You know, now that we live in the present, can we then go back and think, maybe he just
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:11.000
    | text      = genuinely didn't understand what words meant?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:14.039
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:15.160
    | text      = I think that then there would be some absurdist sentences that had-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:21.319
    | text      = That's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:22.319
    | text      = Eventually you'd get something that was like-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:24.519
    | text      = An AI hallucination kind of thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:26.480
    | text      = Yeah, you're right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:27.480
    | text      = You'd have an episode that was like Lynchian.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:31.160
    | text      = And I don't think that's happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:32.920
    | text      = I think it's intentional.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:22:33.920
    | text      = That's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
